en: A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a rustic scene with a thatched-roof building, several people in early 20th-century clothing sitting at tables outdoors under large trees, some standing and serving, and another wooden structure in the background. The overall atmosphere is that of a countryside inn or restaurant. The text is in German and printed in a traditional style at the top and along the side.
